meta.title: Studio
meta.description: The design studio's page: a brief composer that opens a prefilled conversation, quick starts for a deck, landing page, motion loop or infographic, and the works library of delivered designs. Each work shows its type, theme and file path, previews HTML in place, exports to PNG or PDF, and can seed a new work in the same visual language. Everything is kept locally under the profile's studio directory.
